'''Senior Coruscant Correspondent''' was a position in the [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] team of ''[[The Coruscant Holo Net]]'' around [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]]. At that [[Time/Legends|time]], the position was held by [[Tho-Masfran Ciss]].
